ios.desc:
Hangout in your neighborhood chatroom. Post and upvote memes & pics, make new friends, and more. The chat rooms grow and shrink depending on who's online, so you’re never overwhelmed. Share your content in real-time with a deliberately small, intimate audience, and get instant feedback. When you're bored, discover what’s trending on the front page, where you can find a leaderboard of the best pictures, jokes, memes, and news from around the world.

It’s a big world out there. Let’s make it smaller!

App features:
- Hangout in a hyperlocal group with people inside your map area
- Share pics, text posts, and links. Upvote and comment on content you find interesting
- The Map screen allows you to see the boundaries of the chat room
- Text to Speech (TTS) for text posts is great for sharing poetry, short stories, or jokes. Say something funny!
- Updoots go brrr
- The Front Page showcases the best trending/viral content submitted from all the rooms

Your safety is a high priority. As a public forum, please be wary of the information you share online. Offensive content will be banned.
